Name: Massive Greenhouse Maps
Author: VetoCV
Description:
[size=3][b][u]PIF version available here[/u][/b]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43465]Massive Greenhouse Maps (PIF)[/url][/size]

[size=5][u]Layouts[/u][/size]
[size=4]Open Layout[/size]
A single, uninterrupted growing area with no pre-defined structure. Plant however you like!
[list]
[*][b]203 x 147 tiles[/b] — 29,841 total planting spots[/*]
[*]Dimensions are divisible by 7, making it perfectly compatible with iridium
sprinklers + pressure nozzles (609 sprinklers for full coverage)[/*]
[/list][size=4]Sprinkler Layout[/size]
The growing area is divided into organized 7x7 plots, each sized to be covered by a single iridium sprinkler with a pressure nozzle.
[list]
[*][b]300 plots[/b] of 7x7 tiles each — 14,400 total planting spots (48 per plot, accounting for one sprinkler per plot)[/*]
[*]A walking path runs through the center vertically which divides the map into two halves. Great for machines or storage[/*]
[/list][size=4]Tree Layout[/size]
A dedicated fruit tree farm with pre-marked planting spots.
[list]
[*][b]51 x 37 grid[/b] — 1,887 total tree spots[/*]
[*]Planting spots are surrounded by the required clear space so trees grow without obstruction[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][u]Features[/u][/size]
All three layouts include:
[list]
[*]Warp totems at the entrance that teleport you to each of the four corners[/*]
[*]Return warps at each corner to bring you back to the entrance[/*]
[*]Water sources at the top and bottom of the map[/*]
[*]Support for giant crops[/*]
[*]Standard greenhouse year-round growing[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][u]Recommended Mods[/u][/size]
[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿[/b] — automate harvesting from trees and processing across the large space[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url]﻿ [/b]— cover ground quickly when planting or harvesting[/*]
[*]A custom warp mod such as[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32585?tab=description]Stardew Waystones[/url]﻿[/b] — set your own warp points throughout the map for faster navigation[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][u]Compatibility[/u][/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with mods that add additional greenhouses, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21778]Build More Greenhouses[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]Incompatible with other mods that replace the vanilla greenhouse map[/*]
[/list][size=5][u]FAQs[/u][/size]
[b]Q: These maps are huge, how do I get around?[/b] A: The warp totems at the entrance let you jump to any corner instantly. For getting around the interior, a custom warp mod like Stardew Waystones lets you place your own warp points wherever you need them.
[b]Q: Can I request changes or new layouts?[/b] A: Suggestions are welcome! I'll do my best to accommodate them when time allows.
[b]Q: Is this compatible with modded crops?[/b] A: Yes. All three layouts use standard tillable soil and greenhouse properties, so any crop-adding mod should work without issue.


[size=5][u]Credits[/u][/size]
[list]
[*][b]sameerxxe[/b] — warp concept inspired by their mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23952]Super Massive Greenhouse[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][b]ConcernedApe[/b] — creator of Stardew Valley and all vanilla assets used in these maps[/*]
[/list]
